entity.crittersandcompanions.dragonfly.d: A colorful insect found near rivers. Has a taste for spider eyes.
entity.crittersandcompanions.dumbo_octop: A friendly cephalopod native to deep oceans. Might help you if you're drowning.
entity.crittersandcompanions.ferret.desc: A tameable animal found in forests and plains that hunts small animals. Has a taste for raw rabbit.
entity.crittersandcompanions.jumping_spi: A tameable arachnid found in forests. Likes dragonfly wings.
entity.crittersandcompanions.koi_fish.de: A colorful fish found in rivers. Keeping a few around might bring good fortune...
entity.crittersandcompanions.leaf_insect: A harmless insect found in forests. Prone to dancing.
entity.crittersandcompanions.otter.descr: A passive animal found in rivers that hunts fish. Giving one a clam may result in a pearl.
entity.crittersandcompanions.red_panda.d: A tameable animal found in jungles that likes sweet berries and bamboo. Will scare off aggressive neutral mobs.
entity.crittersandcompanions.sea_bunny.d: A passive animal that roams the ocean floor. A bottle might be able to get some of that slime off...
entity.crittersandcompanions.shima_enaga: An ambient bird native to snowy biomes that can be tamed with seeds.
A massive, stocky creeper found in badlands. Completely immune to knockback.
entity.creeperoverhaul.bamboo_creeper.de: A tall, wobbly thing that wanders bamboo jungles. Not aggressive and doesn't explode, but will defend itself if provoked.
entity.creeperoverhaul.beach_creeper.des: A mottled creeper found washed up on beaches.
entity.creeperoverhaul.birch_creeper.des: An overgrown creeper that blends into birch forests.
entity.creeperoverhaul.cave_creeper.desc: A solidly-built creeper found in caves. Might drop ores if it doesn't explode.
A ghastly stump that found in dark oak forests. Explosions inflict temporary blindness.
entity.creeperoverhaul.desert_creeper.de: A sturdy sandstone construct found in deserts. Hard to push around.
entity.creeperoverhaul.dripstone_creeper: A squat creeper found in dripstone caves. Has rocks-for-brains.
entity.creeperoverhaul.hills_creeper.des: A laid-back slab of stone that wanders windswept biomes. Won't explode unless attacked.
entity.creeperoverhaul.jungle_creeper.de: A shorter relative of creepers found in jungles. Overgrown with grass and flowers.
A mushroom that's grown legs. Where did you find this?
entity.creeperoverhaul.ocean_creeper.des: An massive, malicious pufferfish found in oceans. Full of poignant toxins.
A tall, many-faced totem found in savannas. Not aggressive and doesn't explode, but will defend itself if provoked.
entity.creeperoverhaul.snowy_creeper.des: A fluffy, neutral creeper at home in snowy biomes. Doesn't explode, but watch the horns.
entity.creeperoverhaul.spruce_creeper.de: A short creeper made of wood and stone found in taiga biomes.
entity.creeperoverhaul.swamp_creeper.des: A menacing but stylish creeper found in swampy biomes.
entity.golemoverhaul.barrel_golem.descri: A reclusive golem found in villages. Gives crops for emeralds, but might drop something rarer if you have enough to spare.
entity.golemoverhaul.candle_golem.descri: A bright-eyed golem made of wax that fends off monsters if set on fire. Spouts flame from its candle at the cost of its own life.
entity.golemoverhaul.coal_golem.descript: A lump of coal brought to life. Attacks monsters when set on fire, but only for a moment.
entity.golemoverhaul.kelp_golem.descript: A mass of kelp made to fight monsters in the water. Empowered by conduits, but dries up on land.
entity.golemoverhaul.netherite_golem.des: A hulking automaton made fron ancient aebris. Large enough to ride, though it doesn't move very fast. Can be empowered with a lava bucket.
entity.golemoverhaul.hay_golem.descripti: An animated scarecrow found in villages. Prevents nearby farmland from being trampled.
entity.golemoverhaul.terracotta_golem.de: A reliable golem made of fired clay that attacks monsters. Can be given a cactus or dead bush to improve its attacks.
entity.golemoverhaul.slime_golem.descrip: A bouncy defender found in caves. Indicates something special about the area it spawns in.
lore.golemoverhaul.coal_golem: A lump of coal ready to be brought to life. Can be thrown.
entity.snuffles.snuffle.description: A harmless, fluffy creature found in snowy biomes that loves baked potatoes. Can be sheared for fluff and styled with magma cream or slimeballs.
lore.snuffles.frosty_fluff: Frosted fur obtained by shearing a snuffle. Can be used as decoration or to quiet your footsteps.
lore.snuffles.snuffle_fluff: Pillow-soft fur obtained by shearing a warm snuffle. Can be used as decoration or to quiet your footsteps.
lore.crittersandcompanions.clam: An unassuming mollusk caught in a body of water. There might be a pearl inside, but you can't seem to pry it open...
lore.crittersandcompanions.sea_bunny_sli: A bottle full of viscous ooze from a sea bunny. Yuck!
entity.ghosts.kodama.description: A curious spirit that roams forests at night. Might give you something for an amethyst shard.
entity.ghosts.small_ghost.description: A seed-like spirit found in forests at night. Seems to find joy in planting saplings.
entity.ghosts.ghost.description: A tameable spirit found in forests at night that likes glow berries. Will light up dark areas if provided with torches.
lore.bountifulfares.violet_bellflower: A vivid flower found in meadows and some forests. Can be used to make tea or scented candles. Plant on farmland to bonemeal.
lore.bountifulfares.chamomile_flowers: A common flower found in temperate biomes. Can be used to make tea or scented candles. Plant on farmland to bonemeal.
lore.bountifulfares.honeysuckle: A common flower found in warm forests that tastes faintly of honey. Can be used to make tea or scented candles. Plant on farmland to bonemeal.
lore.bountifulfares.tea_leaves: Fresh tea leaves collected from a tea shrub. Can be used to make tea, scented candles, or dried to concentrate its flavor.
lore.bountifulfares.dried_tea_leaves: Dried tea leaves collected from a tea shrub. Can be used to make tea or scented candles.
lore.bountifulfares.tea_shrub: A vibrant bush found in jungles that produces berries. Can be sheared to harvest tea Leaves.
lore.bountifulfares.tea_berries: Ripe berries picked from a tea shrub. Can be used to make red dye, or replanted.
lore.bountifulfares.orange: A ripe citrus picked from an orange tree. Can be made into sweets, or fermented to extract its essence.
lore.bountifulfares.lemon: A ripe citrus picked from a lemon tree. Can be made into sweets, or fermented to extract its essence.
lore.bountifulfares.plum: A plump fruit picked from a plum tree. Good on its own, but can be made into a varity of foods.
lore.bountifulfares.hoary_apple: An odd, brown fruit that resembles an apple. Seems edible enough.
lore.bountifulfares.lapisberries: Lapis-blue berries from an age long past. They have a strange flavor.
lore.bountifulfares.coconut: The massive seed of a palm tree. Can be replanted, or split on a cutting board.
lore.bountifulfares.passion_fruit: A tough fruit with sweet, pulpy seeds inside, harvested from a vine.
lore.bountifulfares.elderberries: Dark, bitter berries harvested from a vine.
lore.bountifulfares.wild_maize: A tall grain that grows in arid biomes.
lore.bountifulfares.maize_seeds: A seed that can be planted to grow maize, or popped and eaten.
tag.bountifulfares.pickets.description: A short fence that can't be walked over. Multiple can be placed in the same block.
lore.bountifulfares.iron_railing: A short, iron rail that can't be walked over. Multiple can be placed in the same block.
lore.bountifulfares.green_tea_candle: A large, green tea-scented candle. It has an invigorating aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.black_tea_candle: A large, black tea-scented candle. It has an inspiring aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.chamomile_candle: A large, chamomile-scented candle. It has a relaxing aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.honeysuckle_candle: A large, honeysuckle-scented candle. It has a sweet aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.walnut_candle: A large, walnut-scented candle. It has an earthy aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.bellflower_candle: A large, bellflower-scented candle. It has an energizing aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.torchflower_candle: A large, torchflower-scented candle. It has an empowering aroma.
lore.bountifulfares.coconut_candle: A small candle made from a coconut shell. Up to three can be placed in the same block.
lore.bountifulfares.flour: A handful of fine flour, used in a variety of baked goods. Can be thrown.
lore.bountifulfares.candy: A honey-flavored piece of hard candy. Yum!
lore.bountifulfares.piquant_candy: A berry-flavored piece of hard candy. Yum!
lore.bountifulfares.sour_candy: A super-sour piece of hard candy. Yum, if you're into that.
lore.bountifulfares.bitter_candy: A bittersweet piece of hard candy. Yum?
lore.bountifulfares.strange_candy: A piece of hard candy with a flavor you can't quite place.
lore.bountifulfares.candied_apple: An apple coated in a thin, sugary glaze.
lore.bountifulfares.candied_plum: A plum coated in a thin, sugary glaze.
lore.bountifulfares.candied_lemon: A sour lemon slice, dried and covered in sugar.
lore.bountifulfares.candied_orange: A sweet orange slice, dried and covered in sugar.
lore.bountifulfares.gristmill: A workstation used to crush things to pieces.
lore.bountifulfares.lapisberry_wine_bott: A bottle of wine made from lapisberries. It has indescribable flavor.
lore.bountifulfares.elderberry_wine_bott: A bottle of wine made from elderberries. The bitterness has faded a bit.
lore.bountifulfares.walnut_mulch: A handful of roughly ground walnuts. Makes a good base for decent compost.
lore.bountifulfares.walnut_mulch_block: A pile of roughly ground walnuts.
lore.bountifulfares.palm_mulch: A handful of roughly ground palm fronds. Makes a good base for decent compost.
lore.bountifulfares.palm_mulch_block: A pile of roughly ground palm fronds.
lore.bountifulfares.packed_coconut_coir: A pile of stiff coconut fibers, packed into a solid block.
lore.bountifulfares.coir_carpet: A carpet made of stiff coconut fibers.
lore.bountifulfares.coir_bricks: A firm block made of coconut coir packed tight to form bricks.
lore.bountifulfares.prismarine_blossom: A crystalline flower produced by a spongekin.
lore.bountifulfares.feldspar_block: A solid block of prevailing earths.
lore.bountifulfares.grass_seeds: A small handful of tiny green seeds. Can be planted on dirt to convert it into grass.
tag.bountifulfares.fruit_logs.descriptio: A thin log from a fruit tree. Not big enough to turn into planks, but it could make a lot of sticks.
tag.bountifulfares.trellises.description: A wooden frame with a thin lattice inside. Can support a variety of plants.
lore.verdant.blue_hibiscus: A lush flower found in jungles. Can be turned into cyan dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.purple_hibiscus: A lush flower found in jungles. Can be turned into purple dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.red_hibiscus: A lush flower found in jungles. Can be turned into red dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.anemone: A purple flower found in jungles. Can be turned into purple dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.dune_grass: A dry, tough bush found in beaches and deserts. Not good for much.
lore.verdant.poker: A vibrant flower that resembles a torch, commonly found in jungles. Can be turned into orange dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.sagebrush: A woody shrub common in badlands.
lore.verdant.dense_grass: Tall and dense grass. Annoying to move through.
lore.verdant.jungle_fern: A larger fern with flat leaves found in jungles.
lore.verdant.clover: A common plant found in flat, open biomes.
lore.verdant.cattail: A common plant found growing on Riverbanks. Can be harvested with shears and processed into Wool.
lore.verdant.monstera: A large vine that grows in jungles. Does well in most conditions.
lore.verdant.salvia: An impressive flower that grows tall in jungles. Can be crafted into red dye.
lore.verdant.dahlia: A rosy flower found in jungles. Can be crafted into red dye or planted in a flower pot.
lore.verdant.stinkhorn_mushroom: A short, inky mushroom that grows in dark places. Can be used to make black dye.
lore.verdant.white_stinkhorn_mushroom: A short, pearly mushroom that grows in dark places. Can be used to make white dye.
lore.verdant.saguaro_block: The thick, pointy stem of a saguaro cactus. Destroys any item that touches it, and can be smelted into green dye.
lore.verdant.saguaro_arm: A thin, pointy arm of a saguaro cactus that destroys any item it touches. Can be placed in a flower pot or smelted into green dye.
lore.verdant.duckweed: A floating plant commonly found in swamps. Also known as water lentils.
lore.verdant.shrub: An ordinary shrub, found in temperate biomes. What more do you want from it?
lore.verdant.aloe_vera: A bright succulent found in deserts.
lore.verdant.flower_crown: A beautiful garland made from azalea flowers.
lore.verdant.conk_fungus: A tough, flat mushroom that grows in many places. Makes a decent substitute for planks.
lore.launchers_and_arrows.rainshot_bow: A powerful bow that can fire up to six arrows at once. Has no movement penalty.
lore.launchers_and_arrows.wave_arrow: An upgraded arrow that bounces once on impact, releasing a damaging wind burst.
lore.launchers_and_arrows.multishot_bow: A modified bow that fires three arrows at once at the cost of damage and accuracy.
lore.minecraft.spyglass: A tool that can be used to see things from afar, useful for identifying new flora and fauna. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.compass: A small compass that points towards your spawn point, or a Lodestone if bound. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.clock: A small clock that tells the time. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.crafting_table: A block that enables more advanced recipes. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.recovery_compass: An unusual compass that points towards the last place you perished. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.totem_of_undying: A golden totem that lets you cheat death. Fits in a backpack's utility slot.
lore.minecraft.lapis_lazuli: A semi-precious stone primarily used to make blue dye. Also necessary for color film.
lore.minecraft.apple: A juicy, red apple picked from an apple tree. Can be eaten on its own, or made into a variety of foods.
lore.minecraft.slime_ball: A gooey glob of slime used to make slime Blocks or sticky pistons. Or you could throw it and slap it around.
lore.minecraft.emerald: A shining green emerald found in deep the mountains. Someone may be interested in this.
lore.minecraft.chicken: A large bird's carcass. Not safe to eat raw.
lore.minecraft.cooked_chicken: A large bird's carcass, thoroughly cooked.
lore.minecraft.short_grass: A modest tuft of grass that grows everywhere. Can be harvested with shears.
lore.minecraft.feather: A soft, white feather dropped by a large bird. Useful for a variety of tools.
lore.minecraft.lantern: A bright, comforting flame encased in a sturdy iron frame. Can be placed to provide light on the floor, a wall, the ceiling, or a catenary.
lore.minecraft.soul_lantern: A dim, chilling flame encased in a sturdy iron frame. Can be placed to provide light on the floor, a wall, the ceiling, or a catenary.
lore.minecraft.rail: A sturdy guide for minecarts. Can be extended several blocks over air before support is needed.
lore.minecraft.powered_rail: A sturdy guide for minecarts that boosts them when powered, and stalls them when not. Can be extended several blocks over air before support is needed.
lore.minecraft.detector_rail: A sturdy guide for minecarts that emits redstone when one passes over it. Can be extended several blocks over air before support is needed.
lore.minecraft.activator_rail: A sturdy guide for minecarts that carries redstone power to blocks in minecarts that pass over it. Can be extended several blocks over air before support is needed.
lore.minecraft.decorated_pot: A fragile pot that can hold over a hundred stacks of a single item. Its sides can be customized with sherds.
tag.minecraft.hanging_signs.description: A smooth sign that connects to walls or ceilings with chains. Can display up to four lines of text, or an item.
lore.beansbackpacks.backpack: A backpack that's perfect for storing lots of little things, but doesn't handle equipment well. Has some room on the side for utilities, like a spyglass.
lore.beansbackpacks.iron_backpack: A backpack that's perfect for storing lots of little things, but doesn't handle equipment well. Has some room on the side for utilities, like a spyglass.
lore.beansbackpacks.gold_backpack: A backpack that's perfect for storing lots of little things, but doesn't handle equipment well. Has some room on the side for utilities, like a spyglass.
lore.beansbackpacks.netherite_backpack: A backpack that's perfect for storing lots of little things, but doesn't handle equipment well. Has some room on the side for utilities, like a spyglass.
lore.beansbackpacks.empty_ender_pouch: A small bundle with a curious texture. It's pitch black inside. [Use] to bind to yourself.
lore.beansbackpacks.ender_pouch: A small, vibrant bundle with a curious texture. Items placed inside may show up elsewhere.
lore.beansbackpacks.bundle: A small, leather bag that can hold a mixed stack of items.
lore.beansbackpacks.lunch_box: A small, metal box that can store a couple mixed stacks of food. [Scroll] to change the selected item.
lore.beansbackpacks.netherite_lunch_box: A sturdy, metal box that can store several mixed stacks of food. [Scroll] to change the selected item.
lore.beansbackpacks.quiver: A long, leather bag made to store several stacks of arrows. [Scroll] to change the selected item.
lore.beansbackpacks.alchemy_bag: A small, leather bag adorned with amethyst. [Use] to smash a potion inside, instantly applying it to yourself.
entity.golemoverhaul.honey_golem.descrip: A sentient beehive that hates undead and can be harvested with shears. There's something buzzing inside of it...
lore.golemoverhaul.honey_blob: A glob of honey harvested from a honey golem. Can be thrown.
lore.kubejs.glyphid_slammer: A foul-smelling concoction of alcohol and bug bits. Nearly undrinkable, but puts a spring in your step.
lore.kubejs.wormhole_special: A spiraling purple beverage with a shimmering foam. Drink with caution and respect.
lore.kubejs.underhill_deluxe: A sweet draft with a lovely, inviting aroma. For hole-dwellers.
lore.kubejs.rock_bearer: A malty brew with a tangy aftertaste. Likely to put hair on your chest.
lore.kubejs.burning_love: A flamin' hot drink with a powerful flavor. Ingest at your own risk.
lore.kubejs.flintlockes_delight: A curious conconction of explosive ingredients. Tastes great- if you like gunpowder, that is.
lore.kubejs.seasoned_moonrider: A sweet, malty brew sure to put a kick in your step.
lore.brushstrokes.wax_brush: A Brush covered in wax. [Use] to select an area to apply wax.
lore.nomansland.cobblestone_bricks: A decorative block of squared cobblestones, interlaced.
lore.nomansland.cracked_cobblestone_bric: A decorative block of cobblestones stones, weathered by time.
lore.nomansland.mossy_cobblestone_bricks: A decorative block of squared stones, covered in moss equally as resilient.
lore.nomansland.mundane_tiles: A drab assortment of alternating clay and stone.
lore.nomansland.polished_stone: A block of stone whose impurities have been polished away.
lore.nomansland.faded_stone_bricks: A block of stone carved into bricks, from eons long past.
lore.nomansland.cobbled_deepslate_bricks: A decorative block made of dark, interlocking stones.
lore.nomansland.siltstone: An unremarkable stone primarily made up of silt.
lore.nomansland.polished_siltstone: A block of siltstone which has become more remarkable by being made less distinct.
lore.nomansland.siltstone_bricks: A block of siltstone, made of unevenly assembled bricks.
lore.nomansland.chiseled_siltstone: A block of siltstone, carved into an intricate pattern.
lore.nomansland.coarse_bricks: Rough bricks made of dirt and clay.
lore.nomansland.mossy_coarse_bricks: Rough bricks made of dirt and clay. Naturally, something has grown.
lore.nomansland.earthen_tiles: Alternating forms of earth worked into decorative tiles.
lore.nomansland.dross_tiles: Dreary tiles one might call decorative, if they were being generous.
lore.nomansland.silt_bricks: A neatly arranged block of tightly packed silt bricks.
lore.nomansland.thatch: A rough, scratchy block made from dried grasses or grains.
lore.nomansland.podzol_path: A block of podzol, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_path: A block of mycelium, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.dirt_path: A block of dirt, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.silt: A common block composed of fine-grained earths.
lore.nomansland.coarse_silt: A loose mix of gravel and silt.
lore.nomansland.silt_path: A block of silt, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.gravel_path: A block of gravel, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.sand_path: A block of sand, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.red_sand_path: A block of red sand, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.icicles: A shelf of icicles, formed under the protection of a tree.
lore.nomansland.snow_path: A block of snow, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.snowy_grass_path: A block of snowy grass, trodden into a path.
lore.nomansland.budding_quartzite: A fragile block of quartzite, ready to grow new quartzite clusters.
lore.nomansland.small_quartzite_bud: The start of a beautiful cluster of quartzite.
lore.nomansland.medium_quartzite_bud: A quartzite cluster still taking shape.
lore.nomansland.large_quartzite_bud: A large cluster of quartzite, soon to be fully grown.
lore.nomansland.quartzite_cluster: A beautiful cluster of quartzite. Drops quartz when broken.
lore.nomansland.pale_cherry_leaves: A block of foliage from a pale cherry tree.
lore.nomansland.field_mushroom_block: The cap of a field mushroom that has grown to monstrous proportions.
lore.nomansland.shelf_mushroom_block: A shelf mushroom grown out of control.
lore.nomansland.field_mushroom: An edible white mushroom commonly found just about everywhere.
lore.nomansland.shelf_mushroom: An edible brown mushroom that prefers to take root on the sides of things.
lore.nomansland.seashells: An assortment of shells washed up on the beach or harvested from a clam. Can be made into various aquatic tools.
lore.nomansland.grass_sprouts: A patch of grass that has just begun to grow. What great potential!
lore.nomansland.oat_grass: A patch of tall, fibrous grass. Too tough to eat.
lore.nomansland.frosted_grass: A patch of grass with icy tips.
lore.nomansland.fiddlehead: A young fern, its fronds yet to unfurl.
lore.nomansland.short_beachgrass: A short patch of grass that thrives in the shifting sands of the beach.
lore.nomansland.tall_beachgrass: A tall patch of grass that has excelled in the shifting sands of the beach.
lore.nomansland.cave_weeds: A deathly weed that has somehow sprouted in the depths of the earth.
lore.nomansland.dried_grass: A stunted patch of grass that can no longer grow.
lore.nomansland.pickleweed: A short, flowering succulent often found in wetland biomes. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.succulent: A hardy plant with thick leaves that grows in deserts. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.barrel_cactus: A small, round cactus found in deserts. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.starflower: A small flower that is but a fair speck in the night. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.thistle: A thorny plant with a regal purple flower. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.autumn_crocus: A toxic plant that tends to flower a little early. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.wild_mint: A bitter, untamed flower with small, delicate petals. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.aconite: A beautiful, indigo flower laced with deadly toxins. It would look nice in a flower pot, at least.
lore.nomansland.yellow_lupine: A tall flower with a golden hue. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.red_lupine: A tall flower with a passionate hue. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.blue_lupine: A tall flower with a sky-blue hue. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.pink_lupine: A tall flower with a pinkish hue. It would look nice in a flower pot.
lore.nomansland.lavender_bush: A plentiful bush of lavender flowers.
lore.nomansland.white_flowerbed: A bed of small, white flowers, often found huddled together.
lore.nomansland.violet_flowerbed: A bed of small, violet flowers, often found huddled together.
lore.nomansland.blue_flowerbed: A bed of small, blue flowers, often found huddled together.
lore.nomansland.yellow_flowerbed: A bed of small, yellow flowers, often found huddled together.
lore.nomansland.red_flowerbed: A bed of small, red flowers, often found huddled together.
lore.nomansland.rafflesia: A massive flower with speckled, scarlet petals. It smells of rotting flesh.
lore.nomansland.clover_patch: A dense patch of varied clovers.
lore.nomansland.ground_ivy: A patch of ivy that has stayed close to the ground.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_growths: An odd growth sprouting from mycelium.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_sprouts: A short growth sprouting from myclium.
lore.nomansland.reeds: A tall, grassy plant found almost anywhere there's water. Might make for some decent twine.
lore.nomansland.cattail: A tall, flowering plant commonly found growing in water. Might make for some decent twine.
lore.nomansland.rose_vines: A vine of roses creeping along a wall. Thorny, but beautiful.
lore.nomansland.beard_moss: A bunch of lichen that hangs from branches.
lore.nomansland.tortoise_egg: A fragile egg laid by a tortoise. It'll hatch, eventually.
lore.nomansland.water_mosaic: A colorful flower that grows in intricate patterns on the surface of water.
lore.nomansland.duckweed: An aquatic plant found just about everywhere in swamps.
lore.nomansland.apple_crate: A crate of bright red apples.
lore.nomansland.pear_crate: A crate of bright green pears.
lore.nomansland.cod_barrel: A barrel filled to the brim with cod.
